# AlgoPuzzle

> AlgoPuzzle is a no-code, block-based visual builder for algorithmic trading strategies. Connect blocks to define entry conditions, risk management, and position sizing, then export a ready-to-run strategy file for MetaTrader 5, MetaTrader 4, or cTrader - no programming required.

AlgoPuzzle generates real platform code from the visual strategy: a MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor (`.mq5`), a MetaTrader 4 Expert Advisor (`.mq4`), or a cTrader cBot (`.cs`), packaged with a setup guide. No account is required to use the builder or claim the free exports. Strategy data stays in the browser and the exported file - there is no server-side database of user strategies.

## Platforms supported
- MetaTrader 5 (MQL5 Expert Advisor)
- MetaTrader 4 (MQL4 Expert Advisor)
- cTrader (C# cBot via cAlgo)

## Pricing
Free to start: the first 2 exports are free, with no account or payment required. Beyond that, pay-as-you-go, one-time payments only (no subscription): $2.00 per additional export, or $9.99 for a 30-day pass with unlimited exports (requires a free login, used only to unlock the pass).
